provenance.note: Outlines from MRSAC's layer; its own population fields are not used because they were captured before the final notification. population is the total printed for each ward in the final notification (sum 2,447,494; the schedule does not name its census year). Wards cross the lines of NMC's GIS zones, and NMC assigns wards to zone offices administratively, so zone_name and zone_no (NMC's own zone number, 1 to 10) are given only where one zone holds at least 90% of the ward (20 of 38 wards) and are null elsewhere; zone_share is the largest share in any one zone. MRSAC's ward layer labels each ward with a zone too, and for 8 wards (1, 8, 17, 22, 29, 32, 33 and 35) its label is not the NMC zone holding most of the ward; wards 1, 8 and 33 lie at least 95% in one NMC zone and keep that zone here, so the two publishers differ on them. MRSAC's ward populations follow the August 2025 draft, with some typing slips and a different 23/26 split: wards 6, 7, 8, 9 and 19 carry a boundary_note because their line moved after the draft, and wards 23 and 26 because MRSAC's line between them is neither the draft's nor the final one. area_sq_km is measured on the outline.
